cases.name: Mikiko Kasahara
cases.about: She was a was a foreign exchange student from Japan attending Texas Lutheran University.
cases.narrative:
The Travis County Medical Examiner’s Office indicated that a bone in her larynx was broken at the joint, and another joint was fused. She also had “profound injury with much hemorrhage within the pelvis,” but that remains a mystery due to the burned state of her body. They concluded she died as a result of homicidal violence including, but not limited to strangulation.
